interface_changes: 训练计划通过页面部件呈现有效输入来源、预算、执行方式、覆盖、产物和未接入的显存估算；开始前要求用户明确输入 start。
续训来源列表展示名称、时间、状态、已完成/计划步数和 checkpoint 摘要；运行必须明确按序号或完整 ID 选择。
external-loop 说明由用户完整循环管理数据与更新，不要求独立 batch 或 loss。
managed-step 与 manual-step 在执行前以同一计划界面展示本次来源、预算和产物；manual-step 的具名优化器更新保留给用户代码管理。
续训必须显式选择候选运行；支持失败和较早成功记录同时存在的情况，不静默回退或自动选中。
implementation: 工作台选择训练模式后只询问该模式需要的入口和参数；external-loop 不通过通用 model/batch 前置表单。
repeat 和 resume 都经过执行计划确认；resume 显式显示父记录、checkpoint、追加步数和自定义状态重置选择。
参数表单空行现在可结束参数输入；:cancel 保持取消整组参数的语义。

validation.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && git diff --check && cargo check --locked --quiet

validation.result: passed: all 214 Rust unit and integration tests across binaries.
passed: 63 worker modules, embedded asset coverage complete, imports follow domain direction.
passed: Rust/Python protocol, API, state formats, and required features match.
passed: PTY verifies managed/manual modes ask for model and batch; manual mode proceeds to the training-step entry, without asking for an external loop.
passed: PTY confirms and executes two managed steps with AdamW defaults; completion and checkpoint are persisted.
passed: PTY confirms and executes a two-step complex multimodal manual-step run; two named optimizer groups update and checkpoint is persisted.
passed: PTY runs a two-step user loop without a model/batch entry; formal record and checkpoint are persisted.
passed: PTY repeat is bound to the selected run snapshot, reports no overrides, and cancellation creates no additional run.
passed: PTY lists a failed run and an older successful run, requires explicit failed-run selection, displays checkpoint/parent/additional budget/reset choice, and cancellation creates no child run.

completion_evidence: Linux PTY mode coverage and actual worker execution validate that the human training plan is connected through to persisted runs/checkpoints.
Repeat and resume flows preserve explicit source selection and do not create runs when the user cancels.
Full test suite and architecture/compatibility gates passed on the completed CLI-10 implementation.
